## What is the lawful basis to use my personal data?

UCD relies on the legal bases of Article 6.1(a) (Consent) and Article 6.1(e) ('Public Interest' / Public Task) of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) to process your personal data. Should any special category (sensitive) personal data be provided accidentally, Article 9.2(j) ('Scientific Research Purposes') applies, and the data will be redacted immediately. Giving consent for data processing under GDPR is separate from ethical consent to take part in the research.
